blocks.text: Cloverdale overall: what sold over the past year

items.t: Across Cloverdale, 306 houses sold at a median of $1,297,500, with the middle half between $1,160,250 and $1,471,250. They took 21 days and closed at 96.8% of the list price, and the median build year was 2000. The typical house sat on a lot of about 6,064 square feet. The median moved from $1,375,000 (November to January) to $1,205,000 (August to October).

Cloverdale townhomes over the past year: 285 sales, a median of $759,000, and a middle half from $691,000 to $825,000. The median home was built in 2009, took 20 days to sell and closed at 97.6% of list. Strata fees were a median $379 a month. The median held near $760,000 from the first quarter to the last.

Across Cloverdale, 127 condos sold at a median of $465,000, with the middle half between $410,000 and $561,250. They took 28 days and closed at 97.0% of the list price, and the median build year was 2010. Strata fees were a median $426 a month. The median moved from $481,250 (November to January) to $467,500 (August to October).

Cloverdale duplexes over the past year: 12 sales, a median of $1,080,000, and a middle half from $1,025,000 to $1,300,000. The median home was built in 2018, took 24 days to sell and closed at 95.4% of list.
